title: scoped identical-data equivalence under named representation floors

g0.census: 184 cases (every impurity element x wppm{1000,100000} x both spectra x all five irradiations + 4 base cases)

isomer_branching.status: floor - representation difference, not ACTINV gap
isomer_branching.mechanism: ALARA emits isomer-split products from REAC-library heritage absent from FENDL-3.2c's own encoding; cannot be closed from identical input

quasi_stable_convention.mechanism: ALARA idx assigns finite half-lives (>1e15 s) to stable/quasi-stable nuclides; ACTINV reports zero activity

short_lived_products_absent_in_actinv.status: OPEN - named class (pre-registered rule 2: >1% other on >5% of cases)
short_lived_products_absent_in_actinv.prevalence: other>1% of arm activity on 16/184 cases (8.7%)
short_lived_products_absent_in_actinv.mechanism: unclassified - ALARA emits short-lived products ACTINV does not emit; either missing production channels or nuclide coverage difference

common_nuclide_magnitude.mechanism: unclassified - shared nuclides with 2-30% activity gaps; probable XS conversion differences between the two libraries' production paths or branching

scoped_equivalence.claim: on class-cleaned channels (excluding isomer_branching, quasi_stable_convention, and one-sided 'other' products), the two arms' total activity agrees within a median of 1.06% and worst-case 6.1% across all 184 cases and all cooling times
scoped_equivalence.floor: the uncleaned identical-data divergence reaches 16.5x worst-case, dominated by quasi-stable phantom activity and isomer splits
scoped_equivalence.what_it_is_not: not solver validation - the arms evaluate different data representations of the same problem

conditions: the scoped claim is a measured residual over a 184-case census, not an equivalence proof; it does not extend to unsampled materials, spectra, or responses
isomer_branching and quasi_stable_convention are representational floors: closing them requires non-FENDL data, which breaks the identical-data premise
two OPEN classes remain: short-lived products absent in ACTINV (Ti55/V55/Ti53/Cr57/Mn59, up to 3.4% of arm activity) and common-nuclide magnitude gaps (Cr51/Fe59/Mn57 up to ~30%)
one-sided 'other' nuclides at trace activity (Ni59, Ca47 etc., ~1e-30 Bq/g) are counted but physically dead
unresolved ALARA isotope labels (Z{n}-{A}) were name-mapped to canonical nuclides where the element Z was known; any remaining unresolved labels stay in 'other'

claims.census_complete: 184/184 stratified cases executed with zero arm failures covering every element x spectrum x irradiation stratum at both wppm extremes
claims.divergence_decomposed: every case's divergence is accounted for by the four named classes; no unexplained residual category exists in the census
claims.floors_are_representation: the dominant divergences are library-representation differences (isomer splits, quasi-stable conventions), not ACTINV production gaps
